info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Insurance Claims Claims Estimates-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Estimates API enables users to access detailed estimates for various insurance claims. This endpoint allows consumers, such as insurance adjusters and claims specialists, to retrieve estimation data, facilitating informed decision-making regarding claim processing. Typically used in claims assessment workflows, the API provides crucial information that assists in evaluating the financial implications of claims. By streamlining access to key data, it enhances the operational efficiency of insurance providers.

get.summary: Retrieve the estimate for a claim.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve an estimate for a specific claim. The estimate includes potential payout values based on the details of the claim submitted, helping users to understand what to expect from their claim process.
